questions.title: Who will win the 2026 Rocket Classic on the PGA Tour?
questions.background: The Rocket Classic is a men's professional golf tournament on the PGA Tour.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The PGA Tour's official final results for the 2026 Rocket Classic.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the golfer officially declared the tournament winner following the final round and any playoff required to determine the champion.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning golfer's full name.

questions.title: What source of cocaine exposure will UK Anti-Doping cite when publicly explaining the resolution of Joseph Parker's October 2025 doping case?
questions.background: Joseph Parker is a former world heavyweight boxing champion from New Zealand. He tested positive for cocaine in connection with his October 2025 fight against Fabio Wardley and has denied knowingly taking banned substances.
questions.resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: UK Anti-Doping's official decision or public statement explaining the resolution of Parker's case arising from the cocaine tests associated with his October 2025 bout.
  • Resolution: Resolve when UK Anti-Doping publicly identifies the source of Parker's cocaine exposure in its explanation of the case's resolution. Use the source identified by the agency.
  • Accepted Answer Format: A concise noun phrase identifying the stated source of exposure.
questions.accepted_format: A concise noun phrase identifying the stated source of exposure.
